dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical geometric narrowing originating at the mid-section and progressing to a sharp tapered posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minimal undulation; lateral margins exhibit a uniform curvature with a slight asymmetrical convexity on the left-central edge.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white; consistent with late-stage transition toward mature white pigmentation.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Faint, low-spatial-frequency grey clusters primarily localized near the anterior apex and along the dorsal ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; no sharp demarcations between varying shades of grey and the off-white baseline canvas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single high-contrast circular aperture at the anterior pole (blowhole); no secondary point anomalies such as rake marks or lesions are visible.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A distinct, elevated longitudinal ridge along the posterior dorsal axis, creating a linear tonal variation and subtle shadow-casting.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent longitudinal linear mark/ridge extending along the posterior dorsal midline.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly defined, dark circular blowhole at the anterior dorsal position providing significant point contrast.
